action: Stop before t-bsb9d9z and ask the operator: (1) restrict the claim to these seven conventions and analyse templates as fixed strata (stratified exact McNemar on the 133 units); (2) measure icc in an arm-A pilot and proceed only if it is at or below the recorded bound; or (3) close FR-40 as below-power.
